item.title: Federal Agents Search Rep. Ilhan Omar's DC Home with DOJ-Approved Warrant
item.description: The Justice Department states the search is part of an ongoing federal investigation, while Omar describes it as targeting political opponents.

item.title: DOJ Investigates TV Networks for Antitrust; Trump Comments on Ukraine Leadership
item.description: The Justice Department is probing several TV networks for possible antitrust violations, as President Trump urges Ukrainians to elect a new leader.

item.title: US drone restrictions strain police budgets
item.description: The US government seeks to end China's dominance in low-cost, high-quality drones, but added restrictions are driving up costs for cash-strapped police departments.

item.title: India opposition marches to court over voter list protests
item.description: Opposition parties say voter list revisions favor Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party. Authorities have removed more than 130 million names.
